### 🟢 Approval recommended It is a focused, behavior-preserving UI refactor with comprehensive new and existing test coverage, clean type-checking, and no objective issues found across all changed files. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR fixes a mobile-app inconsistency where a tool cut off by a terminated turn only showed the amber "terminated" state inside `ActivityGroup`. The lone `ToolBubble` and the `ToolDetailModal` previously rendered the server's synthesized placeholder result with no terminated styling. The change extracts the shared predicate and presentation into a new `chat/ToolTermination.tsx` module so all three surfaces render identically and can't drift, matching the dashboard's `ToolBubble`/`ToolGroup`. **Changes:** - New `chat/ToolTermination.tsx` exposing `getToolTermination` (shared predicate), `TerminatedIcon`, and `TerminatedNote`; `ActivityGroup` now consumes these instead of its inline block. - `ToolBubble` shows the amber icon + an always-visible note and threads `toolResultTerminatedReason` to `onOpenDetail`; `ChatView` and `MessageBubble` carry the new trailing argument through. - `ToolDetailModal` gains a `toolResultTerminatedReason` prop and replaces the raw synthesized result with the amber note when the turn was terminated. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `packages/​app/​src/​components/​chat/​ToolTermination.tsx` | New shared module: termination predicate, amber icon, and note components. | | `packages/​app/​src/​components/​chat/​ActivityGroup.tsx` | Replaces inline termination logic/icon with the shared helper; drops the now-unused `describeTurnTermination` import. | | `packages/​app/​src/​components/​chat/​ToolBubble.tsx` | Renders header icon + always-visible note for terminated tools and passes the reason to `onOpenDetail`. | | `packages/​app/​src/​components/​chat/​ToolDetailModal.tsx` | Adds `toolResultTerminatedReason` prop; amber note replaces the synthesized result. | | `packages/​app/​src/​components/​chat/​MessageBubble.tsx` | Extends the `onOpenDetail` type signature with the trailing reason argument. | | `packages/​app/​src/​components/​ChatView.tsx` | Threads `toolResultTerminatedReason` through `handleOpenDetail` state and into the modal. | | `packages/​app/​src/​components/​__tests__/​ToolBubble.terminated.test.tsx` | New tests: icon/note presence, stopped vs terminated label, controls, and reason handoff. | | `packages/​app/​src/​components/​__tests__/​ToolDetailModal.terminated.test.tsx` | New tests: note shown, placeholder withheld, label, and controls. |
Review effort: Balanced
